script_text: Taurus, this week completely rewrites everything you thought you knew about love and career ambition. Mercury squares your 10th House of career Monday, causing serious miscommunications at work. Mars trines your 4th House Tuesday, restoring quiet inner energy. Wednesday morning remains your weakest point. The major turning point arrives Wednesday when Venus, ruler of your Earth sign Taurus, enters your 5th House of romance and creativity, opening a bright door to unexpected love. By Thursday, Sun joins Jupiter in Leo activating your 11th House, boosting social connections and career visibility. Saturn opposes your 7th House on Sunday, so avoid forcing relationship conversations. Wednesday is your true power day because Venus enters your 5th House. Monday is your worst day because Mercury squares your 10th House and clouds professional judgment. Channel the Venus transit by pursuing a creative passion project Wednesday evening. Follow for daily updates.
